announcements.headline: EQS-News: SMT Scharf AG publishes third-quarter 2026 results
announcements.insight: SMT Scharf AG publishes third-quarter results following a forecast adjustment in October. Shareholders should monitor how these figures align with the revised guidance.

announcements.headline: EQS-News: SMT Scharf AG adjusts its forecast for FY 2026 and continues to implement strategic initiatives
announcements.insight: SMT Scharf AG adjusts its forecast for FY 2026. This follows the publication of H1 2026 results and preliminary nine-month results in August and October 2026.

announcements.headline: EQS-Adhoc: SMT Scharf AG: Publication of preliminary results for the first nine months of 2026 and adjustment of revenue and earnings forecast for FY 2026
announcements.insight: The company adjusted its FY 2026 revenue and earnings forecast following the publication of preliminary results for the first nine months. This guidance change follows earlier H1 2026 results released in August.

announcements.headline: EQS-News: SMT Scharf AG publishes results for the first half of 2026
announcements.insight: SMT Scharf AG publishes results for the first half of 2026. This follows a May strategy update and an August notice regarding financial report publication.

announcements.headline: EQS-AFR: SMT Scharf AG: Preliminary announcement of the publication of financial reports according to Articles 114, 115, 117 of the WpHG [the German Securities Act]
announcements.insight: SMT Scharf AG has published financial reports as required by German law. This follows its May strategy update on electric mobility.

announcements.headline: EQS-News: SMT Scharf AG is successfully pursuing its strategy in the field of electric mobility
announcements.insight: The company confirms it is pursuing its electric mobility strategy. Shareholders should monitor for specific details regarding progress or financial implications.
